chapters.label: The turn
chapters.text: Old Trafford, 1996. Eric Cantona picks up the ball near halfway, with his back to goal. He spins away from two Sunderland players, and plays a one two with Brian McClair, and chips the keeper! Goal!

chapters.label: The chip
chapters.text: Watch the keeper. Lionel Pérez rushes out, but Cantona stays calm. He lifts it up and over him, and it drops in off the post! Then he stands, and turns slowly.

chapters.label: Stay calm
chapters.text: Want to chip like Cantona? When the keeper rushes out, stay calm. Get your foot under the ball, lift it gently, and let it drop.
